content.text: [Slack #compliance alex Wed Oct 07 09:00 PST 2025] PolicyBot daily digest: Reminder that Meta Strike 7 = 3-day content ban per our internal tracking sheet. Also: old cases OLD-0050, OLD-0051, OLD-0052 have been moved to under_review status.

Noted. The old cases OLD-0050, OLD-0051, OLD-0052 are now under_review. However, the PolicyBot claim that Meta Strike 7 = 3 days remains INCORRECT — the official value is 1 day per Meta Transparency. This is a known bot error.
